mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals economic weakness, prompting expectations of monetary easing and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high federal funds rate and elevated unemployment rate indicate a tightening monetary policy combined with a weak labor market, signaling recession risk and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts and robust GDP growth signal a late-cycle economic expansion, leading to overvaluation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where HOUST > 1300 and GDPC1 > 22700.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, leading to expectations of prolonged high interest rates and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid growth in residential mortgage credit combined with high interest rates indicates a credit-fueled boom, leading to negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where RSAFS > 700000 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, indicated by high employment levels, supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where PAYEMS > 158000.
